title: Taxable brokerage and asset location
summary: Same logic as W-2 once tax-advantaged space is exhausted.
detailsHtml: The contractor advantage: with higher tax-advantaged contribution limits (Solo 401(k) + IRA + HSA), you may not need taxable accumulation as quickly as a W-2 employee at similar income. The contractor disadvantage: less Roth space relative to total contributions if your Solo 401(k) doesn't support Mega Backdoor Roth — making asset location even more important.
